claim: Patchline ships a university curriculum network adopting gate-backed assignments across multiple courses. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the curriculum network claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make university-curriculum-network-gate`.
